features: PROBLEM SOLVER. Provides a convenient way to bond your shielded Ethernet patch panel to ground without a formal bonding infrastructure. Great for residential and small business applications making use of a wall mounted equipment rack.

SAFE. Hot and neutral prongs are not wired and simply provided for enhanced physical stability. Conductivity takes place at the third “ground” prong. The durable green colored 14 AWG UL 1015 stranded copper wire provides both heat and fire resistance.

VERSATILE. Provides earthing without altering your existing AC grounding system. Use in any standard three prong NEMA 15A or 20A receptacle. Brass 3.70mm Y terminal allows for use in multiple applications that need a proper path to ground.

DURABLE. Metal three prong plug built to withstand multiple plugins without breaking, yet is safe to use. Molded NEMA plug is permanently attached to the 14 AWG stranded bond wire. Requires a properly wired and grounded AC receptacle that is up to Code. Always test your receptacles with a three prong tester prior to use of this adapter.
✓ FIELD TESTED, CUSTOMER APPROVED. Designed as an accessory for use with our Shielded 24 Port 19” Toolless Modular Patch Panel (B0BWGQSSQW). Backed by our FOREVER WARRANTY.

top_reviews.review_title: Hard to find a comparable item - slightly larger gauge would be better
top_reviews.review_text:
If you need to ground something with a finished appearance (i.e. not in an enclosure), it is hard to beat this, even if it is a big pricey.  Trying to find a plug to build your own results in a much bulkier plug. A slightly heavier gauge wire would be better for use cases as grounding a surge arrestor device.

top_reviews.review_title: Used with DLink 2.5GHz unmanaged switch to drain EMI
top_reviews.review_text:
Needed a shielding drain ability on a 90 foot outdoor shield cable run. The DLink 2.5GHz unmanaged switches has an EMI drain screw on back of them.  Nice for a sub $100 switch. Blessed find.  Hope TrueCable creates a 10 GHz coupler with drain attachment for their TruePlug so that DIY single run shielded cable have easy EMI drain option for those that don't need a switch. Not everyone has a shielded patch panel to drain EMI : )
Read more

top_reviews.review_title: Not What I Wanted; It'll Do, For Now...
top_reviews.review_text:
I have a ham shack in my home office. The problem is that the room is on a upper story far away from suitable grounding and bonding options other than the grounding plug of my 3-prong outlets. I have set up a bonding bar to tie the equipment together but I wanted a cable that would connect the bar to one of my grounded outlets.For the most part, this cable is what I want. However, the gauge of the wire is too thin for my wishes. I shortened the cord length from 6 feet to 3 and replaced the end with a larger ring connector for better contact to my bonding bar.The best I can say is that it will do for now, until I can find something better.
